job: Follow a setup in order, one numbered step at a time, each with its prose and code.
purpose: An ordered list on a rail: each step has a number disc, a title and a body of prose, code or media, and a done step shows a tick. Pure CSS: it needs no script, so a site's steps rail (fd-site-steps data-layout="rail") keeps none of the docs behaviour in a slim build.
useWhen: A setup must happen in order and each step has prose and code.
A site's steps section with code or media beside each step: fd-site-steps with data-layout="rail" holds this list.

avoidWhen.when: The setup differs by tool and the reader picks theirs first.
A first-run flow or a wizard in the product.
Live progress of a run or an agent's work.

states.name: done
states.how: data-state="done" on the fd-doc-step: a tick in the disc

parts.role: The ordered list; it numbers its steps.
One step: its number disc and the rail to the next.
The action the step asks for.
Prose, code or media; add fd-prose for rendered Markdown.
